data.long_meaning: The name Khufaf is derived from the Arabic word 'khafaf' which means 'fawn'. This name is a beautiful tribute to the newborn, symbolizing the innocence, purity, and grace of a young fawn in nature. The name Khufaf carries the meaning “Fawn” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Khufaf usually hope their child will grow to embody fawn and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Khufaf is believed to have a spiritual meaning rooted in the Islamic tradition. The name is said to evoke the qualities of humility, gentleness, and patience. The spiritual significance of the name is often linked to the story of Prophet Yusuf (Joseph) in the Quran, who embodied these virtues throughout his life.
